title: Best Text Animation Designers (2026): Kinetic Typography Videos
description: How to hire a text animation designer for kinetic typography, lyric videos, titles or social clips: timing, fonts, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Text animation designers make words move: kinetic typography videos, animated quotes, lyric videos, title sequences and captions for social media. Good text animation keeps viewers reading and matches the rhythm of voice or music. Projects go wrong when the text moves too fast to read, fonts are not licensed, or the animation does not sync with the audio. This guide helps you get text animation that is clear and engaging.

faq.a: Animated text that moves in time with a voice-over or music, often used for explainers, quotes and lyric videos.

faq.q: Can the text sync with my audio?
faq.a: Yes. Send the final audio first, so the animator can time each word or phrase to it.
Fonts must be licensed for video use. Use your brand fonts or ask the animator to choose properly licensed fonts.
Usually MP4 in the sizes you need: vertical, square or widescreen. Some animators also supply transparent versions for overlays.
Each line should stay on screen long enough to read comfortably. Test with someone who has not seen the text before.
